name: RepRapper Tech (Repraper Tech Co., Limited)
summary: Hong Kong-registered (Kowloon) filament and 3D-printer company founded in 2012 and one of the oldest Amazon filament brands, claiming three filament lines and about 200 t/yr output in China. Broad catalog from PLA/PLA+ in 3-5 kg spools through silk, coextruded, aluminium-filled PLA, ABS, nylon and PVB. It supplies RepRap Warehouse's house-brand filament.

oem_relationships.notes: RepRap Warehouse states its house-brand filament comes from 'a trusted partner RepRapper Tech' (retailer statement).

product_lines.name: PLA+ / MPLA
product_lines.notes: A retailer claims NatureWorks 4032D resin (unverified); 5 kg PLA+ about $70.

product_lines.name: Dual / Tri-Color Coextrusion PLA
product_lines.notes: Multi-colour coextruded PLA; finish not specified in the notes, so the base PLA id is used.

product_lines.name: Flexible
product_lines.notes: Elastomer chemistry (TPU vs TPE) and hardness not stated, so no id is asserted.

product_lines.name: POM
product_lines.notes: Acetal; no POM id exists in the catalog.

additional_notes: Seller of record on Amazon is 'REPRAPPER TECH Co., LIMITED'; the company also sells 3D printers and components. The RepRap wiki lists repraper.com as its website (not verified as current). 2012-13 RepRap wiki reviews of the then 'RepRap-Walmart' filament were mixed to negative on diameter consistency. A possible link to Shenzhen Hello 3D appeared only as a search co-hit: rumoured, uncorroborated. No relationship to any extruder already in the catalog was found.

provenance.conflicts: Company profile (Kowloon address, founding 2012, 3 lines, ~200 t/yr) comes from a Made-in-China profile snippet and is self-reported; the 3DPrint.com aluminium-PLA detail was also read as a snippet only.
